title: The Night Clerk

cards.text: Room 14 calls the front desk every night at 2:14.
Nobody has stayed in Room 14 since I started working nights.
The caller only whispers one question: "Is the night clerk still there?"
I always say yes, and the line goes dead.
Last night, the new manager offered to cover the end of my shift.
At 2:14, I was already halfway home.
My phone lit up with the hotel's number.
The whisper said, "Thank you for leaving the desk to me."
The hotel never hired a new manager.

outro: Follow for a new story every night.
